subject: HelixHealth renewal: staged price-protection + capacity uplift request
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@helixhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-02T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal planning — ask for temporary price protection + uplift

Hi Mina,

We are getting close to our annual renewal and want to explore a short-term path that gives us capacity headroom for Q1 while we finalize our long-term commit next quarter. High level: HelixHealth is asking for a 3–6 month price-protection (freeze) on our per-token rate and a one-time uplift of +20% capacity to handle a push for a pilot program.

Key asks:
- 3-month price freeze starting Jan 1, or until signed long-term amendment (whichever comes first)
- One-off capacity uplift (+20% of current commit) available immediately for 90 days
- A credit to offset uplift cost if long-term commit signed by Mar 31

Can you advise what flexibility Redwood has here? We want to avoid breaking procurement cycles but need predictability for our internal teams.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Jenkins
VP, Product Engineering
HelixHealth

[Attachment: current_usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 12 KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — ask for temporary price protection + uplift

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and clear asks. Short answer: we can get close to what you described, but I want to propose an operationally simple path and surface trade-offs.

Proposal (quick summary):
- 90-day price-protection window (Jan 1 — Mar 31) that holds current per-token list rate, applies to existing model family only (no new external add-ons).
- Immediate one-time capacity uplift of +20% provisioned to your Dedicated pool for 90 days; usage over uplifted capacity billed at normal overage rates.
- If HelixHealth signs a 12‑month committed amendment by Mar 31, Redwood will apply a one-time credit equal to 50% of uplift consumption during the protection window (credit applied to the first invoice under the new term).

I attached a draft workbook with numbers based on the snapshot you sent. This keeps short-term risk low for both sides and creates a clear incentive to move to a committed term.

Open items I want Ben and Marissa to weigh in on: whether finance can accept a 50% uplift-credit (I proposed it as a balance) and whether we need a nominal non-refundable deposit to reserve burst capacity during the uplift window.

If that structure looks OK to you, we can circulate a pricing term sheet and route a quick approval internally.

Best,
Mina
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: HLX-renewal-proposal-20261102.xlsx (Excel, 2 sheets)]

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@helixhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-03T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — ask for temporary price protection + uplift

Thanks Mina — that looks promising. A couple clarifying Qs from my side (procurement):

1) Is the 50% uplift-credit conditional only on the signature date (by Mar 31), or also contingent on minimum consumption during the window? Helix would prefer the credit to apply as long as uplift capacity was used; we can accept a consumption floor if Redwood needs it.

2) Any expectation for a deposit or prepayment? We may be able to expedite approvals if there's clear billing treatment for the uplift (credit vs prepaid).

3) If we move to a 12-month committed contract by Mar 31, can the price-protection window be retroactive to Jan 1 even if the amendment signs in Feb?

We want the commercial language tight because our legal/procurement team is sensitive to retroactive credits.

Appreciate it — Tom
Tom Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager | HelixHealth
procurement@helixhealth.com

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 11:47 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sara — thanks for the note and clear asks. Short answer: we can get close to what you described...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — ask for temporary price protection + uplift

Folks — looping in pricing/finance perspective. I ran numbers with ops and legal. Below is a workable commercial term we can offer with limited risk exposure: 

- Price-protection window: 90 days (Jan 1 — Mar 31). Price held at current hosted per-token rate for covered usage on listed model family.
- Uplift provisioning: +20% provisioned to Dedicated pool for 90 days; any usage over uplift billed at agreed overage rate (same as today).
- Uplift credit: If Helix signs a 12-month committed amendment by Mar 31, Redwood issues a one-time credit equal to 40% of uplift consumption during the protection window (credit applied against invoices in the first 90 days of the new term). We adjusted to 40% to de-risk.
- Deposit: We request a nominal $25k non-refundable reservation deposit to secure uplift capacity. Deposit credited against first invoice under new committed term if signed by Mar 31; otherwise applied to uplift invoices.
- Retroactivity: If the amendment is signed after Jan 1 but before Mar 31, price-protection applies back to Jan 1. If signed after Mar 31, no retroactive credit.

Attached term-sheet and sample invoice calculation. If you want to push credit higher, we can — but would need a larger deposit or a minimum uplift consumption guarantee.

Ben
Director, Strategic Pricing | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | (650) 555-0123

[Attachment: HLX-price-protection-terms-20261104.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)]

From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@helixhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-05T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — ask for temporary price protection + uplift

Mina / Ben — thank you. HelixHealth is prepared to accept the structure with the updated numbers (40% uplift credit + $25k deposit) under the following confirmations: 

- Deposit: we will issue the $25k deposit once legal receives a short term-sheet (procurement needs the deposit to be non-refundable if we don't sign the long-term amendment).
- Retroactivity: agreed that signature by Mar 31 makes the protection retroactive to Jan 1.
- Execution: please send a short term-sheet and DocuSign link and we will route signatures (I will own product signoff; Tom/procurement will route finance/legal).

If you can get the DocuSign link into our inbox by EOD Monday, I'll escalate internally to secure the deposit.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Sara
VP, Product Engineering | HelixHealth

- Redwood to send term-sheet + DocuSign (Mina)
- Helix to issue $25k deposit once term-sheet received (Tom)
- Close: target signed committed amendment by Mar 31 to trigger credit (both sides)
